name: Website content inventory review
summary: Each quarter, or before a redesign or migration, the website owner gets one review built from the page export of their content management system: pages past their stale date, pages with no owner, title and description gaps, old drafts and likely duplicates, each by page ID, with counts that tie to the export.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own original method for a periodic review of a website's page export: stale dates by page type, owners, titles and descriptions, old drafts and likely duplicates.
